text:
Priya (oncall): seeing a cluster of node crashes in aps1 this morning, symptoms: repeated kernel oops + ECC correctable spikes on GPUs in rack-11. 3 nodes rebooted automatically around 07:12 UTC.
Alex (eng-infra): thanks. any correlation with last night's firmware push?
Priya (oncall): yes — those hosts got fw v2.14.3 at 02:30. crashlogs show nvml reports + pcie link flaps.
Jordan (eng-runtime): stack traces look like memory controller timeouts, probably driver/firmware combo. can we isolate which GPU SKUs?
Priya (oncall): all A100-80GB in that rack.
Carlos (hw): confirming — same batch, vendor lot B7. historical ECC counts were low. after fw they jump to hundreds/hr.
Lia (sre): immediate plan: drain the three affected nodes, shift active inference traffic to eu-west fallback pool and spin temporary Dedicated capacity in us-east to cover the delta. OpsBot, can you enqueue drain jobs?
OpsBot: queued drain for hosts: aps1-r11-n3, aps1-r11-n4, aps1-r11-n5. ETA to cordon+drain: ~3 mins.
Alex (eng-infra): Jordan, Lia — recommend canary rollback of firmware to v2.14.1 on one node to verify. if stable, we rollback the rest. Carlos — can we image one spare with older fw?
Carlos (hw): yes we have two spares on site that still have v2.14.1. can reimage and swap. swapping would take ~25m each.
Jordan (eng-runtime): also enable strict eviction policy for GPU jobs to free up memory faster: set JOB_EVICT_TIMEOUT=30s for the drains. Lia — could that impact long-tail jobs?
Lia (sre): short term yes, but we prioritize platform health. we'll notify long-running customers. file an incident page.
Priya (oncall): traffic shift in progress: currently 62% us-west capacity, shifting ~18% to eu-west. API latencies bumped 60ms on average during shift.
Alex (eng-infra): cost note — moving to eu-west Dedicated will add ~+18% per-hour cost if sustained >2h. call out to finance if we expect >8h.
Jordan (eng-runtime): rollback result on aps1-r11-n3 (canary): after reimage to v2.14.1, no ECC spikes for 45m. no reboots.
Carlos (hw): continuing hardware soak on the other spare. ready to swap remaining two nodes once drain completes.
Priya (oncall): drains finished for n3/4/5. starting swapper. routing rules updated: prefer us-west healthy nodes, fallback to eu-west autoscaled pool.
Lia (sre): alerting customers with affected routes and updating status page.
Alex (eng-infra): follow-up: open a change to block v2.14.3 firmware rollout until vendor confirms fix. file CR for rollback across aps1 and aps2.
Jordan (eng-runtime): created PR for automatic detection: if ECC_correctable_rate > 100/min for 10m -> cordon node and notify HW team.
Priya (oncall): capturing list of affected hosts and serials, attaching to incident ticket: INC-2024-3387.
Carlos (hw): vendor contacted, they'll triage on call at 14:00 UTC. sharing logs now.
Lia (sre): we'll keep eu-west autoscaled pool up for 4h then reassess. ops: monitor cost burn and signal if >$X/hour threshold.
Alex (eng-infra): great. after swaps finish, we'll run a 2-hour soak with v2.14.1 then schedule a controlled re-roll when vendor clears.
Priya (oncall): thanks everyone. will update incident page and close thread once all nodes replaced and metrics stable for 2h. :white_check_mark:
